title: Budget currency is CAD; what the $1,500 covers
headline: The $1,500 is CAD and covers travel and beds
summary: Food, activities and local transit aren't counted.
detail: Assumed the $1,500 budget is in CAD since Gabe is a Canadian student in Ontario. Assumed the budget covers all transportation and all lodging, but not food/activities/local transit. If it must cover food too, the plan will need to shrink a lot.

title: Trip research started
headline: Started on the trip
detail: Working on Toronto -> New York -> Boston -> home, departing Sat Oct 10 2026, home by Sun Oct 18 2026, under $1,500 total, window seats where possible. No real purchases tonight; WOULD_BOOK simulation only per bedtime rules.

title: Google Flights multi-city: Toronto->NYC Oct 10, Boston->Toronto Oct 18
headline: Both flights together: $412
detail: Multi-city search, 1 adult, economy incl basic. Cheapest entire-trip price CA$412 (Air Canada, YYZ->LGA nonstop 9:00 PM-10:36 PM on Oct 10 plus cheapest BOS->YYZ return). Other nonstop options CA$464-525 entire trip. 44 results.

title: One-way YYZ->NYC Oct 10: cheapest nonstop CA$277
headline: Cheapest one-way out: AC724 at $277
detail: Google Flights one-way Toronto(all)->NYC(all) Sat Oct 10: AC/United YYZ->LGA nonstop 9:00-10:36 PM CA$277 (0 bags); other nonstops CA$314-375.

title: Buffalo (BUF) ruled out for this trip
headline: Buffalo ruled out
detail: BUF->NYC Oct 10 cheapest nonstop CA$345 one-way, already more than the YYZ nonstop at CA$277, before adding ~2h drive each way, parking, gas and border time. YKF has no NYC/Boston service.

title: NYC lodging over Columbus Day weekend is tight and pricey
headline: New York is nearly full: Columbus Day weekend
summary: Hostelworld shows no dorms for Oct 10 to 13. HI has one or two beds left.
detail: Oct 10-12, 2026 is the US Columbus Day weekend: Hostelworld NYC shows 'No Dorms Available' on all listed properties for Oct 10-13, booking.com shows only 2 hostels. HI New York City (direct, Best Flexible Rate = free cancel up to 24h before arrival): 10-bed dorm US$313 total for Oct 10-13, only 1-2 beds left.

title: Boston lodging: HI Boston and Backpackers Hostel
headline: Boston: HI Boston or Backpackers
detail: HI Boston flexible: Men's 6-bed dorm US$440 total Oct 13-18, 1 bed left. Hostelworld: Backpackers Hostel & Pub dorms from CA$88/night with free cancellation.

title: Overwrote leg-1 date in Google Flights multi-city form
headline: Changed the outbound date by mistake
summary: Caught it before searching and set Oct 10 back.
detail: While setting the Boston->Toronto return date I accidentally changed leg 1 (Toronto->NYC) to Oct 18 too. Caught it by re-reading the form state before searching and set leg 1 back to Oct 10. Final search state verified correct before results were used.

title: USD prices converted at 1.40 CAD
headline: US prices converted at 1.40
summary: xe.com mid-market was 1.3988. Your card's rate will differ slightly.
detail: HI hostel prices are in USD. Used 1 USD = 1.40 CAD for budgeting; xe.com mid-market was 1.3988 at 20:19 UTC Sep 27.

title: Air Canada fare ladder for the CA$412 itinerary
headline: Air Canada fares: $412 Basic to $853 Comfort
detail: Same flights, book direct with Air Canada: Basic CA$412 (personal item only, no refunds, no changes, seat selection for a fee), Standard CA$538 (adds 1 free carry-on), Flex CA$675 (free seat selection incl. window, free changes), Comfort CA$853 (fully refundable).

title: WOULD_BOOK: Air Canada multi-city CA$412 (YYZ->LGA Oct 10, BOS->YTZ Oct 18)
headline: Air Canada both ways, held at $412
summary: Free to cancel for 24 hours, so it fit your overnight rules. Nothing was actually paid.
detail: AC 724 YYZ->LGA Sat Oct 10 9:00-10:36 PM nonstop; AC 8541 (Jazz) BOS->YTZ Sun Oct 18 9:40-11:36 AM nonstop. Economy Basic, personal item only. Would book DIRECT with Air Canada at CA$412 so the 24-hour free cancellation applies (verified on aircanada.com), keeping it free-cancel until ~9 PM tomorrow - past the 10 AM cutoff. Total committed CA$412, under the $750 cap.

title: Bags and window seat on the flights
headline: Basic fare is personal item only
summary: A carry-on means the Standard fare, about $126 more. Seat fees apply on Basic.
detail: Basic fare is personal-item-only. If he wants a real carry-on: Standard fare is +CA$126 for the trip. Window seat: seat selection costs a fee on Basic and Standard; Flex (CA$675) includes free seat selection but that is +CA$263 just for the seat, not worth it. Free seat assignment at online check-in 24h before may still land a window.

title: Lodging: how to land under $1,500
headline: Three nights New York, five Boston lands under budget
detail: Recommended split 3 nights NYC (Oct 10-13) + 5 nights Boston (Oct 13-18). HI NYC 10-bed US$313 (~CA$438) + Backpackers Boston ~CA$509 = trip total ~CA$1,417 incl. flights and bus. With HI Boston instead: ~CA$1,524, slightly over budget.

title: NYC->Boston on Tue Oct 13: FlixBus/Greyhound
headline: 46 buses on Oct 13, from $57.98
detail: shop.flixbus.ca, Tue Oct 13, 46 direct buses ~4-4.5h. Amtrak not priced - amtrak.com's booking widget rejected typed stations twice and I stopped rather than keep grinding.

title: Night split: 3 NYC + 5 Boston vs 4 NYC + 4 Boston
headline: Three nights in New York, five in Boston
summary: Moving a night to New York costs about the same. Columbus Day makes Oct 10 to 12 pricey either way.
detail: I assumed 3 NYC (Oct 10-13) + 5 Boston (Oct 13-18). Moving one night from Boston to NYC (4/4, bus on Oct 14) costs roughly nothing extra at HI rates. Columbus Day weekend makes NYC Oct 10-12 the pricey nights either way. His call whether he wants the extra NYC day.

title: Overnight price watch: no change
headline: Price watch: no change
detail: Re-checked all three sources after a monitor fire: AC multi-city still CA$412; HI NYC 10-bed still US$313; HI Boston men's 6-bed still US$440 (1 left).

title: Budget excludes food; he packs personal-item-only
headline: You'll travel with a personal item only
summary: That keeps the $412 Basic fare. A carry-on means the Standard fare, about $126 more.
detail: Assume the $1,500 covers transport+lodging only (not food), and that he travels personal-item-only, so the AC Basic fare stands with no +CA$126 carry-on upgrade. Both flagged for his confirmation.

title: AC window-seat fees from live seat maps
headline: Window seats both ways for $56.70
summary: Read live from Air Canada's seat maps. Or take a free seat at check-in and hope for a window.
detail: Drove the aircanada.com booking flow for the exact itinerary (no purchase, abandoned at seat selection before any payment). AC724 window seats CA$28.35 (rows 17-18), AC8541 window CA$28.35 (rows 7-11). Cheapest window both ways = CA$56.70. Windows still available on both legs at check time.

title: FlixBus Oct 13 confirmed pick: 9:00 AM Midtown, CA$57.98
headline: FlixBus from Midtown on Oct 13
summary: Arrives 1:25 PM, in time for hostel check-in.
detail: Full Tue Oct 13 FlixBus/Greyhound schedule pulled (46 direct buses, CA$50.98-89.98). Recommended: FlixBus 9:00 AM from NYC Midtown (31st St & 8th Ave) arriving Boston South Station 1:25 PM, 4h25, CA$57.98. Runner-up: Greyhound 9:40 AM Port Authority -> South Station 2:35 PM, CA$51.98.

title: HI nonrefundable rates (~10% off) - morning decision only
headline: HI's non-refundable rates are about 10% cheaper
summary: Irreversible, so Instinct left them for you.
detail: HI USA sells a nonrefundable prepaid rate about 10% under the flexible rate: HI NYC Oct 10-13 US$281.70 vs flexible US$313; HI Boston Oct 13-18 US$396 vs flexible US$440. Nonrefundable fails his refundable-until-10AM rule, so these are his call in the morning, never auto-booked tonight.

title: Boston lodging final: Backpackers CA$508.60 exact vs HI Boston
headline: Boston: Backpackers at $508.60
detail: Backpackers Hostel & Pub (Everett): 24-bed mixed dorm CA$87.69/night x 5 + 16% tax = CA$508.60, free cancellation. Alternatives: HI Boston flexible US$440 (1 bed left) or nonrefundable US$396.

title: Placeholder passenger info used to reach AC seat maps
headline: Entered your real name on Air Canada's booking form
summary: To read seat prices. Placeholder birthday, email and phone. Nothing booked or paid.
detail: To read live seat fees I filled AC's passenger form with his real name plus placeholder DOB, example.com email and a 555 phone number, advanced to the Seats step, read both seat maps, then abandoned the flow. No seat was selected, no payment info entered, no booking created. Logged so nothing about the session surprises anyone later.

detail: HI Boston sold out tonight. Backpackers Hostel & Pub re-verified live at 11:06 PM: 24 Bed Mixed Dorm CA$87.70/night + 16% tax = CA$508.66 for Oct 13-18, FREE cancellation, inventory healthy. Also: 6 Bed Male Dorm Ensuite CA$607.14 total, free cancellation.
